affected.product: Mapster WP Maps — Mapbox, MapLibre & Google Maps for WordPress

descriptions.value: The Mapster WP Maps — Mapbox, MapLibre & Google Maps for WordPress plugin before 2.0.7 does not perform any authorization check when saving edits made through its bundled photo-gallery library, allowing any authenticated user with at least Contributor-level access to overwrite the title and content of, and write arbitrary metadata onto, any post, page or media attachment on the site regardless of ownership.

descriptions.description: CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

assertions.title: Mapster WP Maps < 2.0.7 - Contributor+ Arbitrary Post, Page and Attachment Modification

title: Mapster WP Maps < 2.0.7 - Contributor+ Arbitrary Post, Page and Attachment Modification
